beforeSong.speaker: stickman
beforeSong.text: That line is supposed to be a wall. It is moving.

beforeSong.speaker: fracture
beforeSong.text: It was never the wall. It was the shape of the room.

beforeSong.speaker: stickman
beforeSong.text: Then I will stop the room from breathing.

duringSong.speaker: fracture
duringSong.text: The beat is splitting. Keep singing.

duringSong.speaker: stickman
duringSong.text: I heard the rhythm. I hear the crack too.

preFinal.speaker: fracture
preFinal.text: I am not the enemy. I am the corruption inside the music.

preFinal.speaker: stickman
preFinal.text: Then the music decides who wins.

afterSong.speaker: fracture
afterSong.text: It closes only when the next song starts.

notes: Original dialogue written for this mod, not copied from any existing FNF mod.
